Enterprising people have many attributes, characteristics and learned skills. These include:
• creativity
• motivation
• problem-solving
• resourcefulness.
Analyse how using two of these skills could help Chinmaya to be successful in his proposed
new enterprise. Use examples from the case study to support your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Chinmaya intends to use his website and social media to advertise his proposed enterprise.
Evaluate whether using only online communication and social media as methods of marketing
is the best decision for Chinmaya’s proposed enterprise. You should consider other methods
of marketing communication in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Analyse two actions that you could have taken which would have improved the success of
the presentation given as part of your enterprise project. Use examples to support your
answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The enterprise process involves the following six stages:
1. identifying the problem or need or want
2. exploring creative solutions
3. action planning
4. implementing the plan
5. monitoring progress
6. evaluation of successes and failures.
Evaluate how important three of these stages were to the success of your enterprise
project. Use examples to support your answer.
